items.title: The top Chern class of a finite locally free module of rank r caps the fundamental class to the cycle of a regular section
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter chow.tex (Chow Homology and Chern Classes)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file chow.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma computes the top Chern class of a finite locally free module of rank r on a scheme X' of delta-dimension n as the class of the zero scheme of a section whose local ideals are generated by regular sequences of length r: c_r(E) cap [X']_n = [Z(s)]_{n-r} (statement lines 8749-8761, tag 0FA9). The proof needs a real induction on r: it pulls back to the projective bundle, constructs the section t of O_P(1) obtained from s, proves that Z(t) represents c_1(O_P(1)) cap [P] by a dimension count and a fibre-by-fibre nonzerodivisor check, then descends the section through the resulting short exact sequence and verifies the length r - 1 regular-sequence hypothesis before applying the induction hypothesis. The auxiliary claim and the descent are the substance, so the claim is H2.
